cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Choose What Matters More
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between emotional safety and the outcome they claim to want.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before we renew this lease, do you want my honest answer about living together or a peaceful dinner?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your honest answer. Just don't say anything that makes me panic.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I can't promise both. Shall I answer, or shall we order?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Answer. But start by saying we're fine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the answer you're choosing for me. Do you still want mine?

mechanism: A controls permission for a difficult answer and rejects B demand for reassuring wording, forcing a choice between honesty and a peaceful meal.
confusable: D99 explains hurt after an action; D106 makes B choose whether to accept potential distress to obtain the desired truth.
comparison: A shared lease and dinner differ from public audition exposure.
seedUse: Use D106-b no-panic honesty request and prescribed fine preface, which expose incompatible conditions without requiring A actual answer yet.
